apps.name: SEUsign
apps.localizedDescription: SEUsign is a free on-device iOS application manager and signer. Sign, install and manage your own apps straight from your device.
apps.subtitle: On-device signing application

news.title: SEUsign 3.1.0
news.caption: The app is now called SEUsign. Same seal mark on the icon, same on-device signer underneath, with the name brought in line with the project.

news.title: SEUsign 3.0.0
news.caption: A new seal icon and a reworked interior: brass accent, refreshed appearance options and a cleaner settings screen. Under the hood it is still the same on-device signer, built on the open source Feather project.
